creature.name: Corrupted Walker
creature.role: Common corrupted infantry; low armor and readable basic melee.

creature.name: Imp
creature.role: Fragile jumping harasser. Native spider leap; short melee reach.

creature.name: Possessed Soldier
creature.role: Slow armored priority target. Armor penetration rewards deliberate attacks.

creature.name: Demon Spawn
creature.role: General-purpose demon infantry; later Forest occupation encounters.

creature.name: Hellhound
creature.role: Fast, fragile pursuit enemy; rare in the first horde, not starter-house sleepers.

creature.name: Warped Brute
creature.role: Slow heavy melee with a warned attack burst and a recovery window.

creature.name: Ashbound Warden
creature.role: First incursion champion. Existing shared victory, co-op scaling and phased assault.

creature.name: Thornback Boar
creature.role: Territorial armored boar with a warned rush; wildlife, never a horde member.

creature.name: Gloomcat
creature.role: Rare nocturnal predator using native cat pounce and pursuit. No invisibility.

creature.name: Crystal Stag
creature.role: Rare neutral magical prey; native timid behavior and valuable crystal harvest.
